chunks: You have called me to war, so leave the people to one side and come out to me, and spare both parties from fighting, so that it may be known which of us has a rusted heart and covered eyes!

key_terms.الْمَرِينُ: The one upon whom is rusted (metaphor for spiritual hardness)

ai.seo_question: What was the purpose of Imam Ali's proposed duel with Muawiya?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) challenges Muawiya to a single combat to spare the Ummah from civil war, framing the duel as a divine test of spiritual clarity versus obstruction. This proposal reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on the leader's inner virtue (khawass) determining political legitimacy, contrasting Ali's readiness to die for truth with Muawiya's perceived concealment of truth behind worldly power.
